list_team_members.title: List team members
list_team_members.description: Everyone on the team, with their id, email, name, role and whether they have been removed. The source of the ids and emails every other tool here takes.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

remove_team_member.title: Remove a team member
remove_team_member.description: Remove someone from the team by user id or email. They lose Cursor access immediately, and any seat they held is freed.

user_id.description: The member's user id. Pass this or `email`.

email.description: The member's email address. Pass this or `userId`.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_daily_usage_data.title: Get daily usage data
get_daily_usage_data.description: Per-day, per-member usage across the team -- lines accepted and rejected, request counts by type and model. Dates are epoch milliseconds, not ISO strings, which is the most common reason this call returns nothing.

start_date.description: Start of the window, epoch milliseconds.

end_date.description: End of the window, epoch milliseconds.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_filtered_usage_events.title: Get filtered usage events
get_filtered_usage_events.description: Individual usage events with token counts, costs and model details -- the record-level view behind the daily rollup. Filterable down to one person, service account, cloud agent or automation.

start_date.description: Start of the window, epoch milliseconds.

end_date.description: End of the window, epoch milliseconds.

email.description: Restrict to one member by email.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_team_spend.title: Get per-member spend
get_team_spend.description: What each team member has spent in the current billing cycle, sortable and searchable. The figure a spend limit is judged against.

search_term.description: Filter members by name or email.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

set_user_spend_limit.title: Set one member's spend limit
set_user_spend_limit.description: Cap one member's spend for the billing cycle. Passing null removes the cap; setting it below what they have already spent stops them using Cursor immediately.

spend_limit_dollars.description: The cap in whole dollars, or null to remove it.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

set_user_spend_limits.title: Set spend limits in bulk
set_user_spend_limits.description: Set spend limits for up to 100 members in one call. A bulk write -- one payload can cut off a whole team, so build it deliberately rather than in a loop.

updates.description: The limits to apply, each {"userEmail": "...", "spendLimitDollars": n}. Up to 100.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

get_audit_logs.title: Get audit logs
get_audit_logs.description: Team activity, security events and configuration changes, filterable by event type, user and time. The record to reach for when a setting changed and nobody remembers doing it.

event_types.description: Restrict to these event types, comma-separated.

output.description: The requested record.

list_billing_groups.title: List billing groups
list_billing_groups.description: The billing groups the team is divided into, each with its spend for the cycle. How a large team attributes cost to departments.

billing_cycle.description: Which billing cycle to report spend for.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

get_billing_group.title: Get a billing group
get_billing_group.description: One billing group with its members and their spend for the cycle.

group_id.description: The billing group's id, from list_billing_groups.

billing_cycle.description: Which billing cycle to report spend for.

output.description: The requested record.

create_billing_group.title: Create a billing group
create_billing_group.description: Create a billing group to attribute spend to a department or cost centre.

type.description: The group type, where the team uses more than one.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

update_billing_group.title: Update a billing group
update_billing_group.description: Rename a billing group or rebind it to a different directory group.

group_id.description: The billing group's id, from list_billing_groups.

name.description: A new name for the group.

directory_group_id.description: The directory group to bind this billing group to.

output.description: The record after the update.

delete_billing_group.title: Delete a billing group
delete_billing_group.description: Delete a billing group. Its members stay on the team, but their spend stops being attributed anywhere.

group_id.description: The billing group's id, from list_billing_groups.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

add_billing_group_members.title: Add members to a billing group
add_billing_group_members.description: Add team members to a billing group, so their spend is attributed to it from now on.

group_id.description: The billing group's id, from list_billing_groups.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

remove_billing_group_members.title: Remove members from a billing group
remove_billing_group_members.description: Take members out of a billing group. They keep their Cursor access; only the cost attribution changes.

group_id.description: The billing group's id, from list_billing_groups.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

list_repo_blocklists.title: List repository blocklists
list_repo_blocklists.description: The repositories and path patterns Cursor is blocked from indexing. The control that keeps a sensitive repository out of the model's context.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

upsert_repo_blocklist.title: Add or update a repository blocklist
upsert_repo_blocklist.description: Block a repository, or particular paths within it, from being indexed. A security control -- widening the patterns exposes more code to the model, narrowing them exposes less.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

delete_repo_blocklist.title: Delete a repository blocklist
delete_repo_blocklist.description: Remove a blocklist entry, so the repository becomes indexable again. Deliberately widens what the model can see, so treat it as a security change.

repo_id.description: The repository blocklist entry's id, from list_repo_blocklists.

output.description: Confirmation that the record was deleted.

get_model_access_configuration.title: Get the model access policy
get_model_access_configuration.description: Whether the team restricts which models may be used, and what happens by default when a new provider or model appears.

output.description: The requested record.

update_model_access_configuration.title: Update the model access policy
update_model_access_configuration.description: Set the team's model access policy -- unrestricted, or a default stance for providers and models Cursor adds later. This decides what happens to models nobody has explicitly reviewed.

new_provider_default.description: What to do with providers added in future.

new_model_default.description: What to do with models added in future.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_model_providers.title: List model providers
list_model_providers.description: Every model provider Cursor offers, with whether the team has enabled it and the parameters it allows.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

set_provider_enabled.title: Enable or disable a provider
set_provider_enabled.description: Turn a whole model provider on or off for the team. Disabling one cuts off every model it offers at once.

provider.description: The model provider's name, from list_model_providers.

enabled.description: Whether the provider is available to the team.

output.description: The record after the update.

list_provider_models.title: List a provider's models
list_provider_models.description: The models one provider offers, with whether each is enabled for the team and any parameter restrictions on it.

provider.description: The model provider's name, from list_model_providers.

output.description: A page of matching records, with whatever cursor or paging fields the provider returns.

set_model_enabled.title: Enable or disable a model
set_model_enabled.description: Turn one model on or off for the team, and optionally restrict the parameters it may be used with. Narrower than disabling the whole provider.

provider.description: The model provider's name, from list_model_providers.

enabled.description: Whether the model is available to the team.

parameters.description: Parameter restrictions to apply to the model.

output.description: The record after the update.
